in_sanskrit.name: Nipen
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the waters
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nipen एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nipuna' meaning 'excellent, able, capable'. In Hindu mythology, Nipen is a name for Lord Vishnu, the god of preservation and protection.

in_hindi.name: Nipen
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the waters
in_hindi.long_meaning: Nipen एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nipuna' meaning 'excellent, able, capable'. In Hindu mythology, Nipen is a name for Lord Vishnu, the god of preservation and protection.

in_tamil.name: Nipen
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of the waters
in_tamil.long_meaning: Nipen ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nipuna' meaning 'excellent, able, capable'. In Hindu mythology, Nipen is a name for Lord Vishnu, the god of preservation and protection.

in_telugu.name: Nipen
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of the waters
in_telugu.long_meaning: Nipen ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nipuna' meaning 'excellent, able, capable'. In Hindu mythology, Nipen is a name for Lord Vishnu, the god of preservation and protection.

in_marathi.name: Nipen
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the waters
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nipen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nipuna' meaning 'excellent, able, capable'. In Hindu mythology, Nipen is a name for Lord Vishnu, the god of preservation and protection.

in_bengali.name: Nipen
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the waters
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nipen একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nipuna' meaning 'excellent, able, capable'. In Hindu mythology, Nipen is a name for Lord Vishnu, the god of preservation and protection.
